title: ProBuilder editor core, settings, menu system

sections.heading: PROBUILDER EDITOR
sections.content:
The `ProBuilderEditor` sealed class (`IDisposable`) serves as the central runtime hub coordinating Scene view GUI rendering, element picking, mouse dragging, keyboard shortcuts, handle drawing, mesh selection state, and external tool integration.

1. State Fields and Constants:
- `k_MouseDragThreshold = 6f`: Distance threshold in screen pixels required before a mouse down-drag transition is classified as an active box/marquee drag rather than a single click.
- `s_Instance` (`ProBuilderEditor`): Internal singleton instance reference exposed via public static property `instance`.
- `s_ShowSceneInfo` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.showSceneInfo"` (default `false`), toggles Scene view mesh info overlays.
- `s_AllowNonManifoldActions` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.allowNonManifoldActions"` (default `false`), enables non-manifold topology actions.
- `s_BackfaceSelectEnabled` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.backFaceSelectEnabled"` (default `false`), controls culling mode (`CullingMode.None` vs `CullingMode.Back`).
- `s_DragSelectRectMode` (`Pref<RectSelectMode>`): Backed by key `"editor.dragSelectRectMode"` (default `RectSelectMode.Partial`).
- `s_ShowHoverHighlight` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.showPreselectionHighlight"` (default `true`), enables preselection raycasting.
- `s_SelectMode` (`Pref<SelectMode>`): Backed by key `"s_SelectMode"` (default `SelectMode.Face`), tracks current selection mode (`Vertex`, `Edge`, `Face`, `TextureFace`, or `None`).
- `m_DefaultControl` (`int`): Passive control ID allocated per frame via `GUIUtility.GetControlID(FocusType.Passive)` and passed to `HandleUtility.AddDefaultControl` to suppress Unity default scene object picking.
- `m_Hovering` / `m_HoveringPrevious` (`SceneSelection`): Stores hovered element references for preselection rendering.
- `m_ScenePickerPreferences` (`ScenePickerPreferences`): Caches active cull mode and rect select mode.
- `m_InitialMousePosition` (`Vector2`): Screen position recorded at initial `MouseDown`.
- `m_MouseDragRect` (`Rect`): Computed bounding rectangle of active drag selection.
- `m_IsDragging` (`bool`): Active marquee drag status flag.
- `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag` (`bool`): Guard flag preventing errant drag processing without prior mouse down.
- `m_WasDoubleClick` (`bool`): Prevents `MouseUp` selection clearing following double-click loop/ring actions.
- `m_wasSelectingPath` (`bool`): Tracks previous state of path selection modifier keys.

2. Lifecycle and Event Coordination:
- Constructor: Disposes any existing instance, subscribes `SceneView.duringSceneGui += OnSceneGUI`, `ProGridsInterface.SubscribePushToGridEvent(PushToGrid)`, `MeshSelection.objectSelectionChanged += OnObjectSelectionChanged`, `selectModeChanged += OnSelectModeChanged`, `VertexManipulationTool.beforeMeshModification += BeforeMeshModification`, and `VertexManipulationTool.afterMeshModification += AfterMeshModification`. Initializes GUI styles, calls `LoadSettings()`, `UpdateMeshHandles()`, `SetOverrideWireframe(true)`, and schedules `UpdateSelection()` via `EditorApplication.delayCall`.
- `Dispose()`: Unsubscribes from all scene and tool events, restores wireframe state via `SetOverrideWireframe(false)`, invokes `OnSelectModeChanged(SelectMode.None)`, triggers `SceneView.RepaintAll()`, and clears `s_Instance`.
- `Refresh(bool vertexCountChanged = true)`: Rebuilds selection handles and triggers `selectionUpdated` event across listeners.

3. `OnSceneGUI(SceneView sceneView)` Event Pipeline:
- Step 1: Validates active override tool: `if (!EditorToolUtility.IsBuiltinOverride(EditorToolManager.activeTool)) return;`.
- Step 2: Initializes GUI styles via `SceneStyles.Init()` (sets up `s_SelectionRect` GUIStyle with icon `"Scene/SelectionRect"` and border offset `(1, 1, 1, 1)`).
- Step 3: Renders mesh handles via `EditorHandleDrawing.DrawSceneHandles(SceneDragAndDropListener.isDragging ? SelectMode.None : selectMode)`.
- Step 4: Invokes `DrawHandleGUI(sceneView)`: during `EventType.Repaint`, if not dragging and `GUIUtility.hotControl == 0`, draws hover highlights via `EditorHandleDrawing.DrawSceneSelection(m_Hovering)`; if dragging, computes normalized screen rectangle `m_MouseDragRect` between `m_InitialMousePosition` and `m_CurrentEvent.mousePosition` and draws `SceneStyles.selectionRect.Draw(m_MouseDragRect, false, false, false, false)`.
- Step 5: Key down handling: if `keyCode == KeyCode.Escape`, `activeOverride == null`, and context is `PositionToolContext`, cancels drag state and exits to GameObject context via `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<GameObjectToolContext>()`.
- Step 6: Preselection raycasting: on `MouseMove` or modifier changes when `s_ShowHoverHighlight` and `selectMode.IsMeshElementMode()` are active, copies hovering state, executes `EditorSceneViewPicker.MouseRayHitTest(m_CurrentEvent.mousePosition, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences, m_Hovering)`, clears `m_Hovering` if distance exceeds `ScenePickerPreferences.maxPointerDistance`, and runs `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseHover(m_Hovering)` if path selection modifier active.
- Step 7: Returns if `Tools.current == Tool.View` (camera navigation).
- Step 8: Command dispatch: responds to `"SelectAll"`, `"DeselectAll"`, and `"InvertSelection"` commands on `EventType.ValidateCommand` and `EventType.ExecuteCommand`.
- Step 9: Checks `EditorHandleUtility.SceneViewInUse(m_CurrentEvent)` to clear drag and reset `hotControl`.
- Step 10: Allocates default passive control `m_DefaultControl` on `EventType.Layout` and routes to `HandleMouseEvent(sceneView, m_DefaultControl)`.

4. Mouse Event Handling (`HandleMouseEvent`):
- Ignores events when `Alt` key is held without an active drag session to enable standard Scene view orbit/pan navigation.
- `MouseDown` (left button, `nearestControl == controlID`): detects double click (`clickCount > 1`) and routes to `DoubleClick(m_CurrentEvent)`. Caches `m_InitialMousePosition`, sets `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag = true`, and sets `GUIUtility.hotControl = controlID`.
- `MouseDrag`: when `Vector2.Distance(mousePosition, m_InitialMousePosition) > k_MouseDragThreshold`, sets `m_IsDragging = true` and requests scene repaint.
- `EventType.Ignore`: if dragging was aborted, executes `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseDrag(m_MouseDragRect, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences)` and resets `m_IsDragging = false`, `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag = false`, and `GUIUtility.hotControl = 0`.
- `MouseUp`: releases `GUIUtility.hotControl = 0`. If `m_WasDoubleClick` is set, resets flag. If not dragging, executes single element pick via `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseClick(m_CurrentEvent, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences)` and calls `UpdateSelection()`. If dragging, completes rectangle selection via `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseDrag(m_MouseDragRect, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences)` and resets drag flags. Resets `UVEditor.instance.ResetUserPivot()` if UV editor is open.

5. Double-Click Dispatch (`DoubleClick`):
- Invokes `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseClick` to obtain targeted mesh.
- If in Edge mode: `Shift` executes `SelectEdgeRing.PerformAction()`; default executes `SelectEdgeLoop.PerformAction()`.
- If in Face mode: `Ctrl + Shift` executes `SelectFaceRing.MenuRingAndLoopFaces()`; `Ctrl` executes `SelectFaceRing.PerformAction()`; `Shift` executes `SelectFaceLoop.PerformAction()`; default selects all faces on mesh via `mesh.SetSelectedFaces(mesh.facesInternal)`.
- Other modes: selects all faces on mesh.
- Updates selection and sets `m_WasDoubleClick = true`.

6. Selection Commands (`SelectAll`, `DeselectAll`, `InvertSelection`):
- `SelectAll()`: In Vertex mode, collects first vertex index of every shared vertex cluster `sharedVerticesInternal[i][0]`. In Face mode, passes `mesh.facesInternal`. In Edge mode, builds universal edges via `mesh.GetSharedVertexHandleEdges()` and populates `Edge` array mapping `sharedVerticesInternal[universal.a][0]` to `sharedVerticesInternal[universal.b][0]`.
- `DeselectAll()`: Sets selected vertices, faces, or edges to null or empty collections.
- `InvertSelection()`: Reverses selection masks for vertices, faces, and universal shared edges.

7. Wireframe Override and Grid Snapping:
- `SetOverrideWireframe(bool overrideWireframe)`: Queries mesh renderers and applies `EditorUtility.SetSelectionRenderState(mesh.renderer, overrideWireframe ? (Highlight | Wireframe) & ~Wireframe : (Highlight | Wireframe))`, stripping Unity built-in wireframe so ProBuilder custom geometry handles render without visual clash.
- `PushToGrid(float snapVal)`: Iterates selected meshes, resolves coincident vertices using `mesh.GetCoincidentVertices(mesh.selectedIndexesInternal)`, executes `ProBuilderSnapping.SnapVertices(mesh, indexes, Vector3.one * snapVal)`, and re-optimizes mesh through `mesh.ToMesh()`, `mesh.Refresh()`, and `mesh.Optimize()`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, `ProBuilderEditor` corresponds to the central `EditorPlugin` node handling `_handles(Object object)`, `_forward_3d_gui_input(Camera3D camera, InputEvent event)`, and `_forward_3d_draw_over_viewport(Control overlay)`. The mouse drag threshold of 6 pixels maps directly to `InputEventMouseMotion` distance checks against `InputEventMouseButton` press positions. Escape key context cancellation transitions from sub-element edit modes back to object spatial transform mode.

sections.heading: SETTINGS
sections.content:
ProBuilder manages user and project preferences through a unified Settings Management architecture encapsulated in `ProBuilderSettings`, `Pref<T>`, `ProBuilderSettingsProvider`, and the backward-compatible `PreferencesInternal` utility.

1. Settings Architecture:
- `ProBuilderSettings`: Static wrapper over Unity SettingsManager using package identifier `"com.unity.probuilder"`. Automatic migration detects legacy `"ProjectSettings/ProBuilderSettings.json"` and relocates it to `PackageSettingsRepository.GetSettingsPath("com.unity.probuilder")`. Registers `EditorApplication.quitting += Save` on initialization. Core APIs include `Save()`, `Set<T>(key, value, scope)`, `Get<T>(key, scope, fallback)`, `ContainsKey<T>(key, scope)`, and `Delete<T>(key, scope)`.
- `Pref<T> : UserSetting<T>`: Generic type binding a preference key, default value, and `SettingsScope` (`SettingsScope.Project` or `SettingsScope.User`). Provides implicit cast operator `public static implicit operator T(Pref<T> pref) => pref.value`.
- `ProBuilderSettingsProvider`: Registers settings UI under `"Preferences/ProBuilder"` via `[SettingsProvider]` and `UserSettingsProvider`. Connects to `ProBuilderSettings.instance.afterSettingsSaved` to invoke `ProBuilderEditor.ReloadSettings()` and `Experimental.AfterSettingsSaved()`.
- `PreferencesInternal`: Legacy obsolete storage bridge maintaining cached dictionary defaults and falling back between project local assets (`"ProBuilderPreferences.asset"`) and global `EditorPrefs`.

2. Complete Preference Inventory by Category:

Category A: General Settings
- Key: `"editor.showSceneInfo"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in General block. Enables mesh statistics overlay in Scene view.
- Key: `"editor.showEditorNotifications"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in General block. Controls popup action notifications.
- Key: `"lightmapping.autoUnwrapLightmapUV"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in General block. Automates UV2 lightmap generation on geometry edits.
- Key: `"lightmapping.showMissingLightmapWarning"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in General block. Warns when baking lightmaps if shapes lack UV2.
- Key: `"editor.showHandleDelta"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in General block. Displays translation, rotation, and scale deltas in Scene view.
- Key: `"editor.stripProBuilderScriptsOnBuild"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in General block. Strips runtime scripts during player build.

Category B: Graphics Settings
- Key: `"editor.showPreselectionHighlight"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in Graphics block. Enables hover highlighting on closest mesh element.
- Key: `"graphics.handlesUseUnityColors"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in Graphics block. Uses Unity editor theme colors when true.
- Key: `"graphics.ditherFaceHandles"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in Graphics block. Renders dithered pattern over selected/hovered faces.
- Key: `"graphics.userSelectedFaceColor"` | Type: `Color` | Default: `Color(0f, 210/255f, 239/255f, 1f)` | Scope: User | UI: Color field.
- Key: `"graphics.userWireframeColor"` | Type: `Color` | Default: `Color(125/255f, 155/255f, 185/255f, 1f)` | Scope: User | UI: Color field.
- Key: `"graphics.userUnselectedEdgeColor"` | Type: `Color` | Default: `Color(44/255f, 44/255f, 44/255f, 1f)` | Scope: User | UI: Color field.
- Key: `"graphics.userSelectedEdgeColor"` | Type: `Color` | Default: `Color(0f, 210/255f, 239/255f, 1f)` | Scope: User | UI: Color field.
- Key: `"graphics.userUnselectedVertexColor"` | Type: `Color` | Default: `Color(44/255f, 44/255f, 44/255f, 1f)` | Scope: User | UI: Color field.
- Key: `"graphics.userSelectedVertexColor"` | Type: `Color` | Default: `Color(0f, 210/255f, 239/255f, 1f)` | Scope: User | UI: Color field.
- Key: `"graphics.userPreselectionColor"` | Type: `Color` | Default: `Color(179/255f, 246/255f, 255/255f, 1f)` | Scope: User | UI: Color field.
- Key: `"graphics.wireframeLineSize"` | Type: `float` | Default: `0.5f` | Scope: User | UI: Float slider.
- Key: `"graphics.edgeLineSize"` | Type: `float` | Default: `1.0f` | Scope: User | UI: Float slider.
- Key: `"graphics.vertexPointSize"` | Type: `float` | Default: `3.0f` | Scope: User | UI: Float slider.
- Key: `"graphics.xRayView"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in Graphics block. Displays occluded selected geometry in faded style.

Category C: Mesh Editing Settings
- Key: `"editor.allowNonManifoldActions"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in Mesh Editing block. Enables non-manifold actions.
- Key: `"editor.autoRecalculateCollisions"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in Mesh Editing block. Automatically updates attached collider bounds on edit.
- Key: `"editor.autoUpdatePreview"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in Mesh Editing block. Real-time action result preview generation.

Category D: Mesh Settings
- Key: `"mesh.userMaterial"` | Type: `Material` | Default: `null` | Scope: Project | UI: Object field. Default material assigned to newly spawned shapes.
- Key: `"mesh.defaultStaticEditorFlags"` | Type: `StaticEditorFlags` | Default: `0` | Scope: Project | UI: Mask dropdown.
- Key: `"mesh.meshColliderIsConvex"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in Mesh Settings block.
- Key: `"mesh.newShapesSnapToGrid"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle in Mesh Settings block. Snaps new shape origins to nearest grid point.
- Key: `"mesh.shadowCastingMode"` | Type: `ShadowCastingMode` | Default: `ShadowCastingMode.On` | Scope: Project | UI: Enum popup.
- Key: `"mesh.newShapeColliderType"` | Type: `ColliderType` | Default: `ColliderType.MeshCollider` | Scope: Project | UI: Enum popup (`None`, `MeshCollider`, `BoxCollider`).
- Key: `"lightmapping.defaultLightmapUnwrapParameters"` | Type: `UnwrapParameters` | Default: `new UnwrapParameters()` | Scope: Project | UI: Custom foldout with hardAngle, packMargin, angleError, areaError.
- Key: `"lightmapping.giWorkflowMode"` | Type: `GIWorkflowMode` | Default: `Iterative` | Scope: User.

Category E: Snap Settings
- Key: `"ProBuilder.SnapSettings.s_SnapAsGroup"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: User | UI: Toggle in Snap Settings block. Preserves relative offsets during vertex snapping.
- Key: `"ProBuilder.SnapSettings.s_SnapAxis"` | Type: `SnapAxis` | Default: `SnapAxis.ActiveAxis` | Scope: User | UI: Enum popup (`ActiveAxis`, `AllAxes`).

Category F: UV Editor Settings
- Key: `"uv.uvEditorGridSnapIncrement"` | Type: `float` | Default: `0.125f` | Scope: Project | UI: Slider range 0.015625 to 2.0.
- Key: `"UVEditor.showPreviewMaterial"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `true` | Scope: Project.
- Key: `"UVEditor.weldDistance"` | Type: `float` | Default: `0.01f` | Scope: Project.

Category G: Dimensions Overlay Settings
- Key: `"s_BoundsDisplay"` | Type: `BoundsDisplay` | Default: `BoundsDisplay.Object` | Scope: User | UI: Enum popup (`Object`, `Element`).

Category H: Experimental Features
- Key: `"experimental.enabled"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle. Enables CSG Boolean and Bezier Shape tools.
- Key: `"experimental.meshesAreAssets"` | Type: `bool` | Default: `false` | Scope: Project | UI: Toggle visible when experimental features enabled.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, project-scoped settings map directly to `ProjectSettings` (`ProjectSettings.set_setting("probuilder/...", value)` with `ProjectSettings.set_initial_value` and property info hints registered in `EditorPlugin._enter_tree()`). User-scoped preferences map to `EditorInterface.get_editor_settings()` (`EditorSettings.set_setting("editors/probuilder/...", value)`).

sections.heading: MENU ACTION BASE CLASS
sections.content:
The `MenuAction` abstract base class provides the execution contract, validation rules, category grouping, UI presentation metadata, and lifecycle events for all operations exposed on the ProBuilder toolbar and menu hierarchy.

1. Enums and Constants:
- `MenuActionState` (`[Flags]` enum):
  - `Hidden = 0x0`: Action is not visible on the toolbar.
  - `Visible = 0x1`: Action button is visible in the toolbar.
  - `Enabled = 0x2`: Action is valid given the current selection and mode.
  - `VisibleAndEnabled = 0x3`: Action is both visible and clickable.
- Menu Paths & Shortcuts Constants:
  - `probuilderMenuPath = "Tools/ProBuilder/"`: Base root path for generated Unity top-level menus.
  - `keyCommandSuper = PreferenceKeys.CMD_SUPER` (`'\u2318'`): Command/Control symbol.
  - `keyCommandShift = PreferenceKeys.CMD_SHIFT` (`'\u21E7'`): Shift symbol.
  - `keyCommandOption = PreferenceKeys.CMD_OPTION` (`'\u2325'`): Option symbol.
  - `keyCommandAlt = PreferenceKeys.CMD_ALT` (`'\u2387'`): Alt symbol.
  - `keyCommandDelete = PreferenceKeys.CMD_DELETE` (`'\u232B'`): Delete symbol.

2. Abstract and Virtual Properties:
- `group` (`ToolbarGroup`, abstract): Categorizes the action (`Tool`, `Selection`, `Object`, `Face`, `Edge`, `Vertex`, `Math`, `Entity`, `Export`, `Debug`).
- `toolbarPriority` (`int`, virtual, default `-1`): Layout ordering priority modifier (0 = first, 1 = second, -1 = no preference, mapped to `int.MaxValue` in sorting comparator).
- `icon` (`Texture2D`, abstract): Icon texture rendered in Context Menu and button.
- `iconPath` (`string`, abstract): Local path to icon resource.
- `tooltip` (`TooltipContent`, abstract): Detailed multi-line tooltip definition.
- `menuTitle` (`string`, virtual): Title displayed on text buttons, defaults to `tooltip.title`.
- `hasFileMenuEntry` (`bool`, protected internal virtual, default `true`): Dictates whether a static `[MenuItem]` wrapper is generated for the Unity main menu.
- `validSelectModes` (`SelectMode`, virtual, default `SelectMode.Any`): Bitmask specifying the modes (`Vertex`, `Edge`, `Face`, or `Object`) where the action is applicable.
- `enabled` (`bool`, virtual): Evaluated dynamically as `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode.ContainsFlag(validSelectModes) && !ProBuilderEditor.selectMode.ContainsFlag(SelectMode.InputTool)`.
- `hidden` (`bool`, virtual): Evaluated as `!ProBuilderEditor.selectMode.ContainsFlag(validSelectModes)`.
- `menuActionState` (`MenuActionState`, property): Combines `hidden` and `enabled` to yield `MenuActionState.Hidden`, `MenuActionState.Visible`, or `MenuActionState.VisibleAndEnabled`.
- `optionsMenuState` (`MenuActionState`, protected virtual, default `MenuActionState.Hidden`): Controls options indicator display.

3. Action Execution & Event Pattern:
- `public static Action<MenuAction> onPerformAction`: Global event raised whenever any toolbar action executes.
- `public event Action changed`: Instance event raised when action properties or contents change.
- Execution Sequence (`PerformAction()`):
  1. Fires `onPerformAction?.Invoke(this)`.
  2. Calls `PerformActionImplementation()` (protected abstract returning `ActionResult`).
  3. Invokes `ContentsChanged()`, which fires the instance `changed` event.
  4. Returns `ActionResult` (containing `ActionResult.Status` and descriptive message).
- Deprecation bridge: `DoAction()` is marked `[Obsolete]` and forwards directly to `PerformAction()`.
- Secondary Settings Action: `PerformAltAction()` calls `DoAlternateAction()`, which opens the modal popup window `MenuOption.Show(OnSettingsGUI, OnSettingsEnable, OnSettingsDisable)`.
- Modern UI Overlay integration: `CreateSettingsContent()` returns a `VisualElement` root containing action parameters for Unity 2023.2+ overlay panels.
- Scene GUI hook: `DoSceneGUI(SceneView sceneView)` allows active actions to render handles or gizmos during scene interaction.

4. Tool Toggling via `MenuToolToggle`:
- `MenuToolToggle : MenuAction` specializes `MenuAction` to manage an `EditorTool` instance stored in protected field `EditorTool m_Tool`.
- `PerformActionImplementation()` inspects `m_Tool`. If active via `ToolManager.IsActiveTool(m_Tool)`, it invokes `ToolManager.RestorePreviousTool()`; otherwise, it calls `ToolManager.SetActiveTool(m_Tool)` and returns `ActionResult.Success`.

5. Action Sorting Comparator:
- `CompareActionsByGroupAndPriority(MenuAction left, MenuAction right)`: Sorts actions by integer enum value of `group`. For actions within the same group, compares `toolbarPriority`, treating negative values as `int.MaxValue` to place unprioritized actions at the end.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, `MenuAction` corresponds to an `EditorAction` or `EditorToolAction` `RefCounted` class. The `validSelectModes` bitmask maps to Godot sub-element editing modes (Vertex, Edge, Face, Object). `PerformActionImplementation()` maps to virtual method `_perform_action() -> ActionResult`, and `onPerformAction` maps to a Godot signal `signal action_performed(action)`.

sections.heading: MENU SYSTEM
sections.content:
The ProBuilder menu system populates Unity top-level menu bar (`"Tools/ProBuilder/"`) and context menus by dynamically discovering and registering `MenuAction` implementations.

1. Menu Action Discovery (`EditorToolbarLoader`):
- Pre-seeded built-in action registry: `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions(bool forceReload)` maintains a cached list `s_LoadedMenuActions`. On first execution or forced reload, it populates built-in instances across categories: Tools (`NewBezierShape`, `OpenMaterialEditor`, `OpenUVEditor`, `OpenVertexColorEditor`, `OpenSmoothingEditor`, `ToggleSelectBackFaces`, `ToggleHandleOrientation`, `ToggleDragRectMode`, `ToggleXRay`), Selection (`GrowSelection`, `ShrinkSelection`, `SelectEdgeLoop`, `SelectEdgeRing`, `SelectFaceLoop`, `SelectFaceRing`, `SelectHole`, `SelectVertexColor`, `SelectMaterial`, `SelectSmoothingGroup`), Object (`MergeObjects`, `MirrorObjects`, `FlipObjectNormals`, `SubdivideObject`, `FreezeTransform`, `CenterPivot`, `ConformObjectNormals`, `TriangulateObject`, `GenerateUV2`, `ProBuilderize`, `Export`, `ExportObj`, `ExportAsset`, `ExportPly`, `ExportStlAscii`, `ExportStlBinary`), All elements (`SetPivotToSelection`, `OffsetElements`, `CutToolAction`), Faces (`DeleteFaces`, `DetachFaces`, `DuplicateFaces`, `ExtrudeFaces`, `ConformFaceNormals`, `FlipFaceEdge`, `FlipFaceNormals`, `MergeFaces`, `SubdivideFaces`, `TriangulateFaces`), Edges (`BridgeEdges`, `BevelEdges`, `ConnectEdges`, `ExtrudeEdges`, `InsertEdgeLoop`, `SubdivideEdges`), Vertices (`CollapseVertices`, `WeldVertices`, `ConnectVertices`, `FillHole`, `SplitVertices`), and Entities (`SetTrigger`, `SetCollider`).
- Reflection-based Plugin Discovery: `SearchForMenuAttributes(List<MenuAction> list)` scans all assemblies in `AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()` (or `CurrentAssemblies.GetLoadedAssemblies()` in Unity 6+). Finds types matching:
  - Derived from `MenuAction` (`typeof(MenuAction).IsAssignableFrom(x)`).
  - Concrete class (`!x.IsAbstract`).
  - Decorated with `[ProBuilderMenuActionAttribute]`.
  - Validates parameterless constructor exists via reflection flags `BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public`.
  - Instantiates via `Activator.CreateInstance(x)` and adds to `s_LoadedMenuActions`.
- Post-discovery sorting: Calls `s_LoadedMenuActions.Sort(MenuAction.CompareActionsByGroupAndPriority)`.
- Type-safe instance retrieval: `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<T>()` performs fast LINQ lookup `GetActions().FirstOrDefault(x => x is T)` and instantiates on demand if missing.

2. Generated Menu Items Architecture (`EditorToolbarMenuItems`):
- Generated static class `EditorToolbarMenuItem` binds menu actions to the Unity menu hierarchy using `[MenuItem(path, isValidateFunction, priority)]` attributes.
- Menu categories and priority baseline constants from `PreferenceKeys`:
  - `menuEditor = 100`: Editors (`Create Bezier Shape`, `Open UV Editor`, or `Open Material Editor`).
  - `menuSelection = 200`: Selection modifications (`Grow Selection &G`, `Select Loop &L`, `Select Ring &R`, `Select Hole`).
  - `menuGeometry = 200`: Object and element geometry operations (`Bevel Edges`, `Extrude %E`, `Merge Faces`, `Bridge Edges`, or `Collapse Vertices`).
  - `menuActions = 300`: Action items.
  - `menuMaterialColors = 400` / `menuVertexColors = 400`: Palette operations.
  - `menuRepair = 600` / `menuMisc = 600`: Mesh diagnosis and repair utilities.
  - `menuExport = 800`: Export formats (`Export Asset`, `Export Obj`, `Export Ply`, `Export Stl Ascii`, `Export Stl Binary`).
- Validation Pattern (`MenuVerify_*`):
  - Verifies context: `if (ToolManager.activeContextType != typeof(PositionToolContext)) return false;` (for geometry actions).
  - Retrieves action instance via `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<T>()`.
  - Updates visual checkmark state via `Menu.SetChecked(menuPath, instance.IsMenuItemChecked())`.
  - Returns `instance != null && instance.enabled`.
- Execution Pattern (`MenuPerform_*`):
  - Retrieves action instance via `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<T>()`.
  - Checks `if (instance != null && instance.enabled)`.
  - Clears active preview via `PreviewActionManager.EndPreview()` or launches interactive settings mode via `EditorAction.Start(new MenuActionSettings(instance, showSettingsOnStart))`.
  - Invokes `instance.PerformAction()` and logs telemetry with `ProBuilderAnalytics.SendActionEvent(instance)`.

3. Dedicated Vertex Color Preset Menus (`MenuItems`):
- `MenuItems` registers 10 shortcut menu items under `"Tools/ProBuilder/Vertex Colors/Set Selected Faces to Preset [0-9] &#0-9"`.
- Unified validation method `VerifyApplyVertexColor()` checks `ProBuilderEditor.instance != null && MeshSelection.selectedVertexCount > 0`.
- Perform methods route to `VertexColorPalette.SetFaceColors(presetIndex)`.

sections.heading: TOOLBAR
sections.content:
The ProBuilder toolbar is built dynamically from the sorted list of `MenuAction` objects obtained through `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()`, combining icon loading, caching, layout grouping, and rich floating tooltips.

1. Toolbar Construction and Grouping:
- The toolbar queries `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()` to assemble actions grouped by `ToolbarGroup`.
- Action buttons dynamically query `action.menuActionState` on GUI render:
  - If `MenuActionState.Hidden` (or `action.hidden` is true), the button is omitted from layout.
  - If `MenuActionState.Visible`, the button is drawn disabled/grayed out.
  - If `MenuActionState.VisibleAndEnabled` (or `action.enabled` is true), the button is active and clickable.
- Secondary Options: Actions with `optionsVisible` display an adjacent options trigger icon. Left-clicking options or Alt-clicking text buttons calls `action.PerformAltAction()`, displaying modal settings via `MenuOption.Show`.

2. Icon Asset Loading (`IconUtility`):
- Base Resource Path: `s_IconFolderPath = "Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/"`.
- Cache: `static Dictionary<string, Texture2D> s_Icons` caches all loaded icon textures in memory. `[InitializeOnEnterPlayMode]` triggers `s_Icons.Clear()`.
- Resolution Algorithm (`GetIcon(string iconName)`):
  1. Checks cache `s_Icons.TryGetValue(iconName, out icon)`. Returns immediately if cached.
  2. Appends `".png"` extension if not already present in `iconName`.
  3. Combines path with `s_IconFolderPath` and loads asset via `EditorGUIUtility.LoadIcon(fullPath)`.
  4. Stores loaded texture in `s_Icons` dictionary and returns the asset.
- Skin Handling: Dark skin icons use prefix `"d_"` in filenames, while light skin uses unmodified filenames.

3. Tooltip Architecture (`TooltipContent` and `TooltipEditor`):
- `TooltipContent` Structure:
  - Properties: `title` (`string`), `summary` (`string`), `shortcut` (`string`).
  - Constructor key formatting: Converts array of `char` shortcut definitions into formatted text strings using `InternalUtility.ControlKeyString` (e.g. converting `CMD_SUPER` to `"Ctrl"` on Windows/Linux or command symbol on macOS, appending `" + "` separators).
  - Style Initialization (`InitStyles()`):
    - `_titleStyle`: Font size 14, bold, richText enabled, textColor `Color.white` (Pro skin) or `Color.black` (Light skin), margin `(4, 4, 4, 4)`, padding `(4, 4, 4, 4)`.
    - `_shortcutStyle`: Font size 14, normal weight, textColor `Color(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 1f)` (Pro skin) or `Color(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.3f, 1f)` (Light skin).
  - Dimension Calculation (`CalcSize()`):
    - Minimum width: `k_MinWidth = 128`, maximum width: `k_MaxWidth = 330`, minimum height: `k_MinHeight = 0`, padding: `pad = 8`.
    - Computes title size via `TitleStyle.CalcSize(TempContent(title))`, adds shortcut width from `EditorStyles.boldLabel.CalcSize(TempContent(shortcut)) + pad`, and clamps to `Mathf.Max(ns.x, 256)`.
    - Computes summary height via `EditorStyles.wordWrappedLabel.CalcHeight(TempContent(summary), total.x)`.
    - Adds separator gap (`16px`) when both title and summary are present, returning final `Vector2` dimensions.
  - Drawing (`Draw()`):
    - Title and shortcut layout in horizontal group separated by `GUILayout.FlexibleSpace()`.
    - Draws horizontal separator line with thickness 1 and color `separatorColor = Color(0.65f, 0.65f, 0.65f, 0.5f)`.
    - Draws word-wrapped summary label via `EditorStyles.wordWrappedLabel`.
- Floating Tooltip Window (`TooltipEditor : EditorWindow`):
  - Singleton window accessed via `TooltipEditor.instance()`, configured with `minSize = Vector2.zero`, `maxSize = Vector2.zero`, `hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave`, and displayed via `ShowTooltip()`.
  - Display logic (`ShowInternal(Rect rect, TooltipContent content)`):
    - Calculates content size via `content.CalcSize()`.
    - Calculates screen DPI ratio `dpiRatio = Screen.dpi / 96f` and effective screen width `Screen.currentResolution.width / dpiRatio`.
    - Positions tooltip to the right of the button with offset `k_PositionPadding = 4`: `p = Vector2(rect.x + rect.width + k_PositionPadding, rect.y)`.
    - Screen boundary clamping: if `p.x + size.x > screenWidth`, repositions tooltip to the left side of the button: `p.x = rect.x - k_PositionPadding - size.x`.
    - Sets window `position = Rect(p.x, p.y, size.x, size.y)` and updates `s_WindowRect`.
    - Background styling when not in Pro skin (`!EditorGUIUtility.isProSkin`) sets `GUI.backgroundColor = new Color(0.87f, 0.87f, 0.87f, 1f)` before drawing `GUI.Box(s_WindowRect, "")`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, toolbar buttons are implemented as `Button` nodes inside an `HBoxContainer` or `GridContainer` in an editor dock or 3D viewport overlay panel. `IconUtility` maps to loading SVG/PNG textures via `ResourceLoader.load("res://addons/probuilder/icons/...")`. Tooltips map to custom `Control` tooltip instances created via `Control._make_custom_tooltip(for_text)`.

sections.heading: SHORTCUTS
sections.content:
ProBuilder registers, dispatches, and validates keyboard shortcuts across three distinct layers: Unity Shortcut Management API, MenuItem attribute key sequences, and hardcoded Scene view event intercepts in `ProBuilderEditor`.

1. Shortcut Management Attributes (`ProBuilderEditorShortcuts`):
- Registered shortcuts target specific context types so that hotkeys only trigger when the user is operating within valid editing states:
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Edit Vertices", typeof(SceneViewMotion.SceneViewContext))]`: Calls `SetSelectMode_Vertex()`, validates via `CheckAndEnterPBContextIfNeeded()`, and sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = SelectMode.Vertex`.
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Edit Edges", typeof(SceneViewMotion.SceneViewContext))]`: Calls `SetSelectMode_Edge()`, validates context, and sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = SelectMode.Edge`.
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Edit Faces", typeof(SceneViewMotion.SceneViewContext))]`: Calls `SetSelectMode_Faces()`, validates context, and sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = SelectMode.Face`.
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Toggle Edit Mode", typeof(PositionToolContext.ProBuilderShortcutContext), KeyCode.H)]`: Invokes `Toggle_SelectMode()`, calling `ProBuilderEditor.instance.ToggleSelectionMode()` which cycles `Vertex` -> `Edge` -> `Face` -> `Vertex`.
  - Context validation helper: `CheckAndEnterPBContextIfNeeded()` checks `if (ToolManager.activeContextType != typeof(PositionToolContext))`. If `EditorToolManager.GetComponentContext(typeof(PositionToolContext), true) != null`, it switches context via `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<PositionToolContext>()`.

2. Additional Context-Specific Shortcuts:
- Path Selection: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Selection/Select Path", typeof(PositionToolContext.ProBuilderShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse0, ShortcutModifiers.Shift | ShortcutModifiers.Action)]`.
- Quick Material: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Apply Quick Material", typeof(MaterialShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse2, ShortcutModifiers.Shift | ShortcutModifiers.Control)]`.
- Dimensions Overlay: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Dimensions Overlay/Toggle Overlay", typeof(SceneView))]`.
- UV Editor Reset: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/UV Editor/Reset Canvas", typeof(UVEditor), KeyCode.Alpha0)]`.
- UV Auto-stitch: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Auto-stitch UV", typeof(UVEditorShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse0, ShortcutModifiers.Action | ShortcutModifiers.Shift | ShortcutModifiers.Alt)]`.
- UV Copy Settings: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Copy UV Settings", typeof(UVEditorShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse0, ShortcutModifiers.Action | ShortcutModifiers.Alt)]`.

3. MenuItem Key Binding Syntax (`EditorToolbarMenuItems` & `MenuItems`):
- Unity MenuItem attributes define key sequences using syntax modifiers:
  - `%`: Control on Windows/Linux, Command on macOS.
  - `#`: Shift key.
  - `&`: Alt on Windows/Linux, Option on macOS.
  - `_`: Single key without modifiers.
- Standard Menu Shortcuts Registered:
  - Extrude: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Extrude %E"` (Ctrl+E) -> triggers `ExtrudeEdges` in Edge mode or `ExtrudeFaces` in Face mode.
  - Flip Face Normals: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Flip Face Normals &N"` (Alt+N).
  - Insert Edge Loop: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Insert Edge Loop &U"` (Alt+U).
  - Smart Connect: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Smart Connect &E"` (Alt+E).
  - Smart Subdivide: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Smart Subdivide &S"` (Alt+S) -> executes `SubdivideEdges` in Edge mode or `SubdivideFaces` in other modes.
  - Split Vertices: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Split Vertices &X"` (Alt+X).
  - Weld Vertices: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Weld Vertices &V"` (Alt+V).
  - Grow Selection: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Grow Selection &G"` (Alt+G).
  - Shrink Selection: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Shrink Selection &#G"` (Alt+Shift+G).
  - Select Loop: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Select Loop &L"` (Alt+L).
  - Select Ring: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Select Ring &R"` (Alt+R).
  - Toggle X-Ray: `k_MenuPrefix + "Interaction/Toggle X Ray &#X"` (Alt+Shift+X).
  - Delete Faces: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Delete Faces _BACKSPACE"` (Backspace key).
  - Vertex Color Presets 0-9: `"Tools/ProBuilder/Vertex Colors/Set Selected Faces to Preset [0-9] &#0-9"` (Alt+Shift+0 through Alt+Shift+9).

4. Hardcoded Scene GUI Intercepts (`ProBuilderEditor.OnSceneGUI`):
- Escape Key: When `m_CurrentEvent.type == EventType.KeyDown && m_CurrentEvent.keyCode == KeyCode.Escape`, if `EditorToolManager.activeOverride == null` and active context is `PositionToolContext`, executes `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<GameObjectToolContext>()`, resets `m_IsDragging = false`, `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag = false`, and consumes the event via `m_CurrentEvent.Use()`.
- Double-Click Modifiers: `Shift` triggers Edge/Face Loop, `Ctrl` triggers Face Ring, and `Ctrl + Shift` triggers concurrent Face Ring and Loop selection.

EditorSceneViewPicker and color picking ray hit testing executed in ProBuilderEditor.OnSceneGUI and HandleMouseEvent.
Rectangular drag marquee selection and DoMouseDrag invoked during mouse drag completion.
Loop and Ring element selections dispatched during double-click operations in ProBuilderEditor.
Move/Rotate/Scale tools, PositionTool, and VertexManipulationTool coordinating scene GUI events and modification hooks.
EditorHandleDrawing and wireframe rendering overridden by ProBuilderEditor and configured via graphics preferences.
ProBuilder toolbar UI panels and overlay integration utilizing MenuAction instances and ProBuilderActionsOverlay.
